metadata.name: epoch
metadata.description: Epoch - Frequent Batch Auction perpetual-futures exchange on Solana

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Cancel an active order before its target batch closes.

instructions.name: clear_batch
docs: Clear an expired batch, execute auction, compute clearing price, and allocate fills.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless cranker invoking clear_batch

instructions.name: create_user
docs: Create a new per-user account for trading and collateral accounting.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit mock USDC collateral into the protocol vault.

instructions.name: expire_and_release
docs: Voids a stale batch and clears users' pending lots/active_orders and releases margin.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless cranker, keeper, or affected user invoking expire_and_release

instructions.name: faucet
docs: Mint mock USDC to caller for testing on devnet / localnet (capped per call).

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: Mock USDC mint.

accounts.name: mint_authority
docs: PDA authority allowed to mint mock USDC.

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: Token account receiving the newly minted tokens.

instructions.name: fund_vault
docs: Fund the Backstop Vault with mock USDC collateral.

instructions.name: initialize_batch
docs: Initialize a zero-copy Batch account for a ring slot.

instructions.name: initialize_market
docs: Initialize the global Market account, mock USDC mint, and collateral vault.

accounts.name: mint_authority
docs: PDA that serves as the mint authority for the mock USDC token.

accounts.name: quote_mint
docs: Mock USDC mint with 6 decimals (1 USDC = 1,000,000 micro-USDC).

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: PDA SPL token account holding all user collateral. Authority is the market PDA.

instructions.name: initialize_vault_user
docs: Initialize the Backstop Vault UserAccount PDA owned by the vault authority PDA.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Liquidate an undercollateralized user position directly against the Backstop Vault.

accounts.name: vault_user
docs: The Backstop Vault's UserAccount PDA that absorbs the liquidated position (spec §10.4).

accounts.name: user
docs: The undercollateralized user account being liquidated.

accounts.name: liquidator
docs: Permissionless caller / liquidator / keeper triggering the liquidation.

instructions.name: place_order
docs: Place or replace (upsert) an order targeting a future or current batch.

instructions.name: settle_users
docs: Settle users for a cleared or void batch in pages.

instructions.name: update_market_params
docs: Admin updates tunable market parameters.

instructions.name: update_vault_params
docs: Admin updates Backstop Vault parameters.

instructions.name: vault_quote
docs: Permissionlessly place the Backstop Vault ladder quotes for a future batch.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraw mock USDC collateral from the protocol vault (flat position rule).

errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: PositionNotFlat
errors.msg: Position must be flat to withdraw

errors.name: RingSlotBusy
errors.msg: Ring slot is busy with an unsettled batch

errors.name: BatchInPast
errors.msg: Target batch is in the past

errors.name: BatchTooFarAhead
errors.msg: Target batch is beyond lookahead window

errors.name: BatchNotCleared
errors.msg: Batch is not cleared or void

errors.name: OracleConfidenceTooWide
errors.msg: Oracle confidence interval is too wide

errors.name: ReduceOnlyExceedsPosition
errors.msg: Reduce-only order exceeds current opposite position

errors.name: CannotExpireClearedBatch

errors.name: InvalidUserAccount
errors.msg: User account does not match any unsettled order in batch

types.name: Batch
docs: Batch account (PDA seed `[b"batch", ring_index]`, zero-copy).
Contains the tick aggregates, clearing results, and up to `MAX_ORDERS` orders.
Size budget: 128 orders × 64 B + 2 × 101 × 8 B + header ≈ 9,936 B ≤ 10,240 B.

fields.name: batch_id
docs: Batch sequence number.

fields.name: status
docs: Current state from `BatchStatus`.

fields.name: num_orders
docs: Number of orders placed in this batch.

fields.name: settled_orders
docs: Number of orders that have been settled.

fields.name: clearing_tick
docs: Clearing tick index (i*), set by `clear_batch`.

fields.name: oracle_price
docs: Oracle price at clear time (micro-USDC per SOL).

fields.name: oracle_conf
docs: Oracle confidence at clear time (micro-USDC).

fields.name: oracle_posted_slot
docs: Slot in which the oracle update was posted.

fields.name: clearing_price
docs: Uniform clearing price (micro-USDC per SOL, multiple of price_tick).

fields.name: matched_lots
docs: Total matched lots (Q*).

fields.name: bid_marginal_tick
docs: Buy-side marginal tick index (t_b).

fields.name: bid_marginal_alloc
docs: Buy-side lots allocated at marginal tick (M_b).

fields.name: bid_marginal_total
docs: Total buy lots at marginal tick (T_b = bid_qty[t_b]).

fields.name: ask_marginal_tick
docs: Sell-side marginal tick index (t_a).

fields.name: ask_marginal_alloc
docs: Sell-side lots allocated at marginal tick (M_a).

fields.name: ask_marginal_total
docs: Total sell lots at marginal tick (T_a = ask_qty[t_a]).

fields.name: bid_qty
docs: Aggregate buy lots at each tick (updated by place/cancel).

fields.name: ask_qty
docs: Aggregate sell lots at each tick (updated by place/cancel).

fields.name: orders
docs: Order buffer, indexed by insertion order.

types.name: BatchCleared
docs: Emitted when a batch is cleared through on-chain auction.

types.name: BatchVoided
docs: Emitted when a batch is marked VOID (e.g. stale oracle or delay).

types.name: InitializeMarketArgs
docs: Instruction arguments for initializing market parameters.

types.name: LiquidateParams
docs: Parameters passed into the permissionless `liquidate` instruction.

fields.name: oracle_price
docs: Oracle price in micro-USDC (6 decimals, e.g. 150_000_000 for $150.00).

fields.name: oracle_conf
docs: Pyth confidence interval in micro-USDC.

fields.name: oracle_timestamp
docs: Publish timestamp of the oracle price update.

types.name: Market
docs: Global market configuration account (PDA seed `[b"market"]`).
One per market. Contains admin keys, oracle config, funding state,
and fee/insurance pools. Zero-copy for efficient on-chain access.
Field ordering: i128 fields first (16-byte aligned), then Pubkeys (32B)
and u64 fields. Avoids implicit padding under `#[repr(C)]`.

fields.name: funding_index
docs: Cumulative funding index, fixed-point with F_SCALE = 10^9.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin authority (devnet only; can update params and fund vault).

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Mock USDC mint address.

fields.name: collateral_vault
docs: SPL token account holding all user collateral.

fields.name: oracle_feed_id
docs: Pyth SOL/USD feed id (32 bytes, verified on-chain).

fields.name: params
docs: All tunable market parameters (inline struct).

fields.name: start_slot
docs: Slot at which batch counting begins; `batch_id = (slot - start_slot) / N`.

fields.name: next_batch_to_clear
docs: Next batch_id that needs clearing (monotonic pointer).

fields.name: last_oracle_price
docs: Last observed oracle price (for display and coarse checks).

fields.name: open_interest_lots
docs: Sum of all long positions in lots (= sum of all short positions).

fields.name: fee_pool
docs: Accrued trading fees in micro-USDC.

fields.name: insurance_fund
docs: Accrued insurance fund in micro-USDC.

fields.name: bad_debt
docs: Cumulative bad debt in micro-USDC not covered by insurance fund.

fields.name: vault_params
docs: Backstop vault parameters (inline struct, 48 bytes).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for the market account.

fields.name: _pad_bump
docs: Padding to align to 8-byte boundary.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved space for future fields without reallocation.

types.name: MarketParams
docs: Market parameters stored inline in the Market account.
All defaults are from `02-MECHANISM_SPEC.md` §1, §9 and `01-ARCHITECTURE.md` §5.1.

fields.name: base_lot
docs: Base lot size in lamports (default 1000 = 0.001 SOL).

fields.name: price_tick
docs: Price granularity in micro-USDC (default 1000 = $0.001).

fields.name: min_order_lots
docs: Minimum order size in lots (default 10).

fields.name: min_order_notional
docs: Minimum order notional in micro-USDC (default 10_000_000 = $10).

fields.name: funding_period_slots
docs: Funding period length in slots (default 72000 ≈ 8 hours).

fields.name: batch_slots
docs: Slots per batch (default 2).

fields.name: lookahead
docs: Lookahead: how many future batches an order may target (default 3).

fields.name: k_ticks
docs: Number of price ticks in the grid (default 101, must be odd).

fields.name: tick_bps
docs: Basis points per tick (default 1).

fields.name: imr_bps
docs: Initial margin requirement in bps (default 1000 = 10%).

fields.name: mmr_bps
docs: Maintenance margin requirement in bps (default 500 = 5%).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Trading fee in bps on filled notional (default 5).

fields.name: liq_penalty_bps
docs: Liquidation penalty in bps (default 100).

fields.name: max_oracle_age_secs
docs: Max oracle age in seconds before rejection (default 10).

fields.name: max_conf_bps
docs: Max oracle confidence / price ratio in bps (default 20).

fields.name: max_clear_delay_slots
docs: Max slots after batch close before VOID (default 4).

fields.name: max_orders_per_batch
docs: Max orders allowed per batch (default 128).

fields.name: funding_cap_bps
docs: Funding rate cap in bps (default 50).

fields.name: _pad0
docs: Padding for 8-byte alignment (offset 62 -> 64).

types.name: Order
docs: Individual order within a Batch (64 bytes, zero-copy).
Layout: `user_pda(32) + lots(8) + filled_lots(8) + tick(2) + side(1) +
slot_id(1) + status(1) + flags(1) + _padding(10) = 64`.

fields.name: user_pda
docs: PDA of the user who placed this order.

fields.name: lots
docs: Requested lot quantity.

fields.name: filled_lots
docs: Lots filled during clearing (set at settlement).

fields.name: tick
docs: Limit tick index in `[0, K-1]`.

fields.name: side
docs: Side: `OrderSide::BUY` or `OrderSide::SELL`.

fields.name: slot_id
docs: User's slot index `[0, 8)` for this batch.

fields.name: status
docs: Lifecycle status from `OrderStatus`.

fields.name: flags
docs: Bit flags from `OrderFlags`.

fields.name: _padding
docs: Padding to 64 bytes.

types.name: OrderCancelled
docs: Emitted when an order is cancelled from a batch buffer.

types.name: OrderPlaced
docs: Emitted when an order is placed into a batch buffer.

types.name: PlaceOrderArgs
docs: Arguments for placing or replacing an order.

types.name: PositionLiquidated
docs: Emitted when an undercollateralized user position is liquidated.

types.name: UserAccount
docs: Per-user account (PDA seed `[b"user", owner.key()]`).
Tracks collateral, positions, funding state, and pending order counts.
One account per user across all batches. Zero-copy for efficient settlement.
Field ordering: i128 fields first (16-byte aligned), then Pubkeys (32B)
and u64/i64 (8-byte), then smaller fields at the end. Explicit padding
ensures no compiler-generated padding bytes exist.

fields.name: quote_position
docs: Quote-ledger position in signed micro-USDC (spec §7).
`Σ(collateral + quote_position)` is conserved across all users (I-1).

fields.name: funding_snapshot
docs: Last funding index value applied to this user.

fields.name: owner
docs: Wallet that owns this account.

fields.name: collateral
docs: Deposited collateral in micro-USDC. Adjusted by fees, realized PnL folds.
Can go negative only via bad debt (I-1).

fields.name: base_position
docs: Net position in signed lots. Positive = long, negative = short.

fields.name: pending_buy_lots
docs: Sum of buy lots in unsettled orders (for worst-case margin).

fields.name: pending_sell_lots
docs: Sum of sell lots in unsettled orders (for worst-case margin).

fields.name: active_orders
docs: Count of active orders across all open batches.

fields.name: flags
docs: Bit flags (e.g., LIQUIDATING).

fields.name: _pad
docs: Padding to 8-byte boundary.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved space for future fields.

fields.name: _pad2
docs: Padding to 16-byte alignment boundary (offset 168 -> 176).

types.name: UserSettled
docs: Emitted when a user's fills, funding, and fees are settled for a batch.

types.name: VaultParams
docs: On-chain parameters for the Backstop Vault demo liquidity engine (architecture §9).

fields.name: quote_offset_bps
docs: Rung offsets in basis points relative to oracle (default [3, 6, 10]).

fields.name: _pad0
docs: Padding for 8-byte alignment.

fields.name: quote_lots
docs: Lot sizes for each rung (default [10, 20, 30]).

fields.name: max_inventory_lots
docs: Maximum allowed position in lots before quoting stops (default 1000).

fields.name: skew_bps
docs: Max inventory skew in basis points (default 5).

fields.name: max_conf_bps
docs: Max oracle confidence in bps before quoting halts (default 15).

fields.name: is_active
docs: Active flag (1 = active, 0 = paused).

fields.name: _pad1
docs: Padding to 8-byte boundary.

types.name: VaultQuoteParams
docs: Parameters for placing the Backstop Vault ladder into a target batch.

types.name: VaultQuoteSkipped
docs: Emitted when the Backstop Vault skips quoting due to an on-chain guard.

types.name: VaultQuoted
docs: Emitted when the Backstop Vault successfully quotes into a batch.
